comment: “Capture once, use many times” can be interpreted as requiring every data item to be captured only once. Health information may need confirmation, correction, updating, reconciliation, or repeated measurement.

citation.raw: §Appendix E, Goal 1 p.236 l.Goal outcome rows

public.text: “Capture once, use many times” can be interpreted as requiring every data item to be captured only once. Health information may need confirmation, correction, updating, reconciliation, or repeated measurement.
public.suggestedRevision: Clarify that authoritative data should be captured at the appropriate source and reused where fit for purpose, while allowing legitimate recapture, verification, and updated observations.
